answer: A livestock movement record with holding register history works as the gate: movements recorded at one holding across seasons. Each of 430 aliases needs its own movement records, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The jetty test is the price tag: 430 fakes mean 430 payments. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The ember signal is visible to every grader, and the pulse ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
